scope: User reports selected words sometimes show no suggestions despite Full Access
findings: Untracked lowercase letter-only controls show suggestions; Kalem/KALEM/İstanbul/QRmenü show none. Revalidates round4 uppercase issue, not a new independent bug.
Selections with edge spaces including NBSP, straight/curly apostrophe, hyphen, or digits show no suggestions.
Decomposed çağrı control still works; no Unicode-normalization defect demonstrated here.
The inspected core selection path has no Full Access gate. Untracked selection fallback requires exact character-to-letter-key mapping and no edge whitespace.
limits: Actual selectedText supplied directly to coordinator; callback delivery/timing in specific apps not tested.
Whitespace rejection currently protects surrounding spacing; correction must preserve it rather than blindly trim and replace.
